scripts.lint: pnpm typegen && oxlint --config ../../.oxlintrc.json --type-aware --tsconfig tsconfig.json api/ server-api/ && oxfmt --config ../../.oxfmtrc.json --check api/ server-api/
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --config ../../.oxlintrc.json --type-aware --tsconfig tsconfig.json --fix api/ server-api/ && oxfmt --config ../../.oxfmtrc.json --write api/ server-api/
scripts.typegen: WRANGLER_LOG=warn wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --config wrangler.toml --env-interface WorkerBindings --include-runtime false
